usedFor: Locate2u raises delivery events, and viaSocket utilities adds a wait with “Pause Workflow” before the next step.

bestTemplate.name: “Stop Status Change” in Locate2u, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A stop status change often needs a gap before follow-up, so the pause waits a set number of minutes.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” only waits for X minutes, so add the step that should run after the delay.
